pages.title: Finding it
pages.text: Look for a tower with Server Blocks in the top room in Cyberland, find the Corrupted Server Block (there may be more than one) and mine it.

pages.title: Battery Obtaining
pages.text: Slay mobs or mine crates until you obtain a battery, then charge it by using it on a Cowbot.

pages.title: Radar Tower
pages.text: Find the Radar Tower, charge the terminal with the battery, then summon the boss!
